From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Align on next steps — 30m product intro (two demo brackets)

Hi Ryan —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking through Skyline's primary latency and multi-tenant concerns. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock a 30-minute intro/demo for your stakeholders: 

What I heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for batch scoring while keeping on-prem data controls.
- Engineering wants to validate end-to-end throughput on a 512-token workload.
- Security interested in KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.

Proposed next step:
- 30-minute product intro (we'll show the hosted flow + Dedicated option + brief Q/A).
- Please nominate a technical attendee from engineering (infra or ML infra) and a security/contact for the KMS questions.

Two time brackets (PDT) — pick one or suggest an alternative:
1) Tue May 11 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT / 1:00–1:30 PM EDT
2) Wed May 12 — 3:00–3:30 PM PDT / 6:00–6:30 PM EDT

Prep material attached: Skyline_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf (brief milestones) and a short pre-demo questionnaire (pre-demo-questions.md).

If those two brackets don't work, happy to propose three alternate windows — just let me know attendee roles and timezone constraints.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com] | +1 (415) 555-0123
